VERDICT: ISSUES
1. `web/app/teams/[team_id]/workflow/WorkflowSettingsClient.tsx:54`: The 400 banner shows the wrong text. The backend's `_http_from_jsonrpc` (`src/mem_mcp/web/handlers/mindmaps.py:88`) returns `detail` as an object `{message, code, data}`. This code only reads `detail` when it is a string, so every create, activate and remap refusal shows "Request failed (400)". The actual reason is lost (for example, an activation refusal or a remap to an unknown stage). The acceptance says "400→banner", and `ErrorBody.detail` is also typed without this object shape.
2. `web/app/teams/[team_id]/workflow/page.tsx:28`: Only 404 from the workflow fetch is handled. With no active workflow, the backend returns 400, not 404, so the page correctly passes `null` to the client. Any other failure, such as a 403 or 500, is also treated as "No workflow defined for this team." That would invite the user to create one. A non-OK, non-400 `wf` should show an error instead.
